fcs_function.name: nav/pitch-mean-deg

fcs_function.name: nav/pitch-mid4-deg

fcs_function.name: nav/pitch-mid3-deg

fcs_function.name: nav/pitch-nearer-deg
fcs_function.description: of two that disagree, the one nearer the reference

switch.name: nav/latch-miscompare

fcs_function.name: ap/link-age-sec

switch.name: ap/latch-link-lost

fcs_function.name: ap/stick-roll

fcs_function.name: ap/pedal

fcs_function.name: ap/protected

fcs_function.name: ap/gain-q

switch.name: ap/speed-target-kcas
switch.description: the commanded speed: the schedule less the operator's offset, or a commanded speed

fcs_function.name: ap/alpha-limit-deg
fcs_function.description: angle-of-attack limit: the lift break less a margin

fcs_function.name: ap/bank-limit-deg
fcs_function.description: bank limit

fcs_function.name: ap/leg-course-deg
fcs_function.description: the leg's course, east of north

fcs_function.name: ap/leg-togo-ft
fcs_function.description: distance to the end of the leg

fcs_function.name: ap/leg-xt-ft
fcs_function.description: cross-track error, right of the leg positive

fcs_function.name: ap/track-error-deg
fcs_function.description: wanted course less ground track

fcs_function.name: ap/ground-error-deg
fcs_function.description: wanted course less heading, on the ground

switch.name: ap/latch-rollout
switch.description: on the runway: set by weight on a main wheel while landing, cleared when landing is switched off

fcs_function.name: ap/flare-height-now-ft
fcs_function.description: the wheel height at which the flare would start now: the design height, or the time to touchdown at the present sink if that is higher

switch.name: ap/flare-height-ft
switch.description: the flare's height, followed until the flare starts and held from then

fcs_function.name: ap/gs-dw2-fps2
fcs_function.description: the wind's departure from its mean, squared, summed over the three axes

fcs_function.name: ap/gust-sigma-kt
fcs_function.description: how gusty the air is: the per-axis rms of the wind about its mean, kt

fcs_function.name: ap/gs-w20e-kt
fcs_function.description: the wind at 20 ft that spread belongs to (sigma_w = 0.1 W20), kt

fcs_function.name: ap/gs-xw-kt
fcs_function.description: the mean wind across the leg's course, kt

fcs_function.name: ap/gs-add-gust
fcs_function.description: the share of the maximum addition the gusts are worth

fcs_function.name: ap/gs-add-cross
fcs_function.description: the share of it the crosswind leaves

fcs_function.name: ap/gs-add-now
fcs_function.description: the addition the air asks for now, kt

fcs_function.name: ap/gs-add-lat-next
fcs_function.description: followed above GS_PICK_H_FT of wheel height (the wheel height reads 1,000 ft above 1,000: it is clipped there), held under it

fcs_function.name: ap/approach-add-used
fcs_function.description: the addition the approach speed carries: the aircraft's own pick, or the one set

fcs_function.name: ap/approach-keas
fcs_function.description: the speed for a lift coefficient of 0.645 at this weight, and ap/approach-add-kt more (0: as it was; the gusty-wind addition of docs/PLAN.md, "Gusts: find out first")

switch.name: ap/latch-bias-pitch-deg
switch.description: ruddervator angle at engagement

switch.name: ap/latch-bias-yaw-deg
switch.description: yaw command at engagement

switch.name: ap/latch-bias-spoiler
switch.description: spoiler position at engagement

fcs_function.name: ap/gamma-deg
fcs_function.description: the flight path angle, deg (small angles)

switch.name: ap/latch-bias-gamma-deg
switch.description: flight path angle at engagement

fcs_function.name: ap/cl-now
fcs_function.description: the lift coefficient the aircraft flies at (weight over dynamic pressure and wing area)

fcs_function.name: ap/cfg-drag-deg
fcs_function.description: the drag of the spoilers and the gear as a flight path angle, deg (drag coefficient over lift coefficient): what the thrust must give up or take on with the configuration

switch.name: ap/latch-bias-cfg-deg
switch.description: configuration drag at engagement

switch.name: ap/latch-theta-latched-deg
switch.description: pitch attitude at engagement

fcs_function.name: ap/speed-error-kt
fcs_function.description: fast is positive

fcs_function.name: ap/theta-speed-entry-deg
fcs_function.description: the bias the speed law starts from: the pitch command less what its proportional term will add

switch.name: ap/latch-theta-speed-bias
switch.description: the pitch command's change from the latched attitude, as it was when the speed mode took over

switch.name: ap/latch-thrust-entry-lbf
switch.description: the engine thrust as it was when the speed mode took over

fcs_function.name: ap/theta-thrust-ff-deg
fcs_function.description: the flight path angle the thrust gained since the speed mode took over makes, deg

fcs_function.name: ap/gs-on
fcs_function.description: the gust system is on: switched on, in the landing, in the air, under GS_H_FT

fcs_function.name: ap/gs-glide-extra-deg
fcs_function.description: pitch more in the glide for the sink beyond the path's that the spoilers cannot take

fcs_function.name: ap/theta-speed-gs-deg
fcs_function.description: the speed law's pitch, not under the floor in the glide while the gust system is on, and the extra for the sink

fcs_function.name: ap/pitch-mode-prev-next
fcs_function.description: the pitch mode of the frame before

fcs_function.name: ap/alt-i-enable
fcs_function.description: the altitude mode's integral runs: near the height, or settled within LEVEL_I_FAR_FT of it

fcs_function.name: ap/alt-error-lead-ft
fcs_function.description: the height error the profile is worked out for: where the aircraft will be after the response time (it overshot the height by 10 to 40 ft, still climbing at the rate the command had left behind)

fcs_function.name: ap/alt-vs-target-fps
fcs_function.description: the climb rate the altitude capture should have at this height error: the soft minimum of the linear law's and the constant deceleration's (2.6 ft/s^2), no more than the thrust holds

fcs_function.name: ap/alt-dir-next
fcs_function.description: the direction the height is in (+1 above), held within 30 ft of it

fcs_function.name: ap/alt-vs-next
fcs_function.description: the climb rate asked for, signed: the climb rate there is while another mode flies; then the profile lagged by 2 s, its growth towards the height limited to 2.6 ft/s^2

fcs_function.name: ap/alt-settled-next
fcs_function.description: the aircraft was settled at the height when the altitude mode took the pitch

fcs_function.name: ap/theta-alt-i-next
fcs_function.description: the small integral of the height error, deg: runs while the gate is open, held (not reset) while it is shut, zero while the altitude mode is not flying

fcs_function.name: ap/theta-alt-offset-in-deg
fcs_function.description: the pitch beyond the path angle that another mode is holding; 0 once the altitude mode has the pitch

lag_filter.name: ap/theta-alt-offset-deg
lag_filter.description: that pitch, followed while another mode flies and let go over 6 s from the frame the altitude mode takes the pitch

fcs_function.name: ap/theta-alt-deg
fcs_function.description: pitch attitude for the climb rate asked for, and the small integral of the height error (the old law's clip of 12 deg held a climb of 17 deg to 12 at the handover: a 0.5 g unload)

fcs_function.name: ap/theta-manual-deg
fcs_function.description: by hand: the stick asks for a rate, 3 deg/s at full travel or what gives 0.5 g more or less than 1, whichever is less (the governor moves at twice the difference)

fcs_function.name: ap/theta-follow-deg
fcs_function.description: in the direct law the command follows the aircraft, so that coming back is bumpless

fcs_function.name: ap/theta-flare-deg
fcs_function.description: the flare's pitch attitude, and the gust system's extra

fcs_function.name: ap/theta-takeoff-deg
fcs_function.description: takeoff: the attitude on the ground until 120 KIAS, then 6.5 deg

switch.name: ap/theta-mode-deg
switch.description: pitch attitude asked for by the mode, from the attitude latched at engagement

fcs_function.name: ap/alpha-ahead-deg
fcs_function.description: angle of attack, looked ahead by hand, and on a rising angle in the glide

fcs_function.name: ap/speed-ahead
fcs_function.description: the factor on speed and Mach number when looked ahead by hand

fcs_function.name: ap/alpha-margin-deg
fcs_function.description: room under the angle-of-attack limit

fcs_function.name: ap/speed-margin-kt
fcs_function.description: room above the lowest speed allowed: 15 kt under the commanded speed. Not on the ground: a takeoff starts from rest

fcs_function.name: ap/protect-fast-deg
fcs_function.description: nose up above Mach 0.63 or 175 KCAS

fcs_function.name: ap/theta-accel-deg_sec2
fcs_function.description: the pitch acceleration that changes the load factor at 0.04 g per second, deg/s^2

fcs_function.name: ap/theta-err-mode-deg
fcs_function.description: the attitude error the mode asks to remove: to what it asks within the governor's limits (-16 to +18 deg), so that the profile stops there and not against the limit

fcs_function.name: ap/theta-rate-profile-deg_sec
fcs_function.description: the pitch rate that the constant deceleration can stop at the attitude asked for, the less of it and of the linear law (2 per second)

fcs_function.name: ap/theta-rate-mode-next
fcs_function.description: the mode's pitch rate: shaped in pitch mode 1 in the air, as it was elsewhere

fcs_function.name: ap/theta-rate-deg_sec
fcs_function.description: how fast the pitch command moves: towards the mode's, or down for angle of attack or speed, whichever is lowest; and never past -16 or +18 deg (the integrator behind it has no limit of its own)

pid.name: ap/theta-governor
pid.description: the pitch command, as a change from the attitude latched at engagement

fcs_function.name: ap/protect-alpha-deg
fcs_function.description: a direct push down in proportion to the angle of attack over its limit, ahead of the governor

fcs_function.name: ap/theta-error-deg
fcs_function.description: nose high is positive

fcs_function.name: ap/pitch-law-deg
fcs_function.description: ruddervators together, trailing edge down positive

fcs_function.name: ap/rollout-w-next
fcs_function.description: the weight of the rollout's nose-down: 0 until the rollout, then up to 1 over ROLLOUT_NOSE_BLEND_S

fcs_function.name: ap/rollout-nose-deg
fcs_function.description: the pitch law with 3 deg of nose-down blended in by the rollout's weight

fcs_function.name: ap/pitch-direct-deg
fcs_function.description: direct law: the angle on entry, the stick, and pitch-rate damping

switch.name: ap/pitch-out-deg
switch.description: on the runway after landing: 3 deg nose-down

fcs_function.name: ap/heading-error-deg
fcs_function.description: right of the nose is positive

fcs_function.name: ap/next-course-deg
fcs_function.description: the next leg's course, from the end of this one to the next waypoint

fcs_function.name: ap/turn-delta-deg
fcs_function.description: the turn at the end of the leg, right positive

fcs_function.name: ap/turn-err-deg
fcs_function.description: the next leg's course less the ground track

fcs_function.name: ap/bank-alpha-cap-deg
fcs_function.description: the bank the angle-of-attack margin allows: acos(1 / n), n the load factor at which the angle reaches its limit less 0.5 deg

fcs_function.name: ap/roll-lag-s
fcs_function.description: the bank's delay behind its target at this speed (rolltest.py), s

fcs_function.name: ap/turn-bank-deg
fcs_function.description: the bank of a turn on a leg: the bank command limit, and what the angle-of-attack margin allows (heading mode and the pilot are not held to the margin)

fcs_function.name: ap/turn-bank-ratio
fcs_function.description: the bank flown over the bank commanded in a turn at this speed, weight and height (turnperf.py)

fcs_function.name: ap/turn-lag-in-s
fcs_function.description: the bank's effective delay rolling in, s (turnperf.py)

fcs_function.name: ap/turn-lag-out-s
fcs_function.description: the bank's effective delay rolling out, s (turnperf.py)

fcs_function.name: ap/turn-moment-out-s2
fcs_function.description: the roll out's sideways drift, s^2: the area between the heading and the instant-roll-out equivalent over the steady turn rate (turnperf.py); times g tan(bank) it is the drift, to the outside, ft

fcs_function.name: ap/turn-bank-flown-deg
fcs_function.description: the bank a turn is flown at: the bank commanded times what the aircraft flies for it

fcs_function.name: ap/alpha-end-deg
fcs_function.description: the angle of attack level flight has at this speed and weight in the configuration the leg ends in: the spoilers at ap/vt-sp-end (pathperf.py)

fcs_function.name: ap/bank-alpha-cap-end-deg
fcs_function.description: the bank the angle-of-attack margin allows level in the configuration the leg ends in (as ap/bank-alpha-cap-deg, at 1 g and without the gusts): steady

lag_filter.name: ap/bank-alpha-cap-lag-deg
lag_filter.description: the angle-of-attack cap of the bank, lagged: what it is on the whole, not in a gust

fcs_function.name: ap/turn-bank-design-deg
fcs_function.description: the bank a turn is designed for: the bank command limit, the steady cap of the configuration the leg ends in and the angle-of-attack cap lagged (the bank commanded)

fcs_function.name: ap/turn-bank-end-deg
fcs_function.description: the bank a turn will be flown at when the leg ends: the design bank times what the aircraft flies for it

lag_filter.name: ap/turn-bank-lead-deg
lag_filter.description: the bank the turn's lead is worked out for: the bank flown, lagged

fcs_function.name: ap/turn-radius-ft
fcs_function.description: the radius of a turn at the bank the aircraft flies, in ground speed

fcs_function.name: ap/turn-wind-cross-fps
fcs_function.description: the wind across the new leg, towards its right, ft/s

fcs_function.name: ap/turn-psi1-deg
fcs_function.description: the heading on the new leg: its course less the crab the wind needs

fcs_function.name: ap/turn-dpsi-raw-deg
fcs_function.description: the heading change to the new leg's heading

fcs_function.name: ap/turn-dpsi-rad
fcs_function.description: the heading change in the turn's direction, rad

fcs_function.name: ap/turn-radius-air-ft
fcs_function.description: the radius of the turn in the air

fcs_function.name: ap/turn-time-s
fcs_function.description: the time the turn takes

fcs_function.name: ap/turn-drift-exit-ft
fcs_function.description: the roll out's drift at the exit across the new line, right of it positive: outward is to the left of the new line for a right turn

fcs_function.name: ap/turn-lead-wind-ft
fcs_function.description: the distance before the corner at which the arc's predicted exit is on the new line, in the wind

fcs_function.name: ap/turn-lead-ft
fcs_function.description: the distance before the corner a turn starts at: where the arc joins the two legs in the wind (the old R tan(delta / 2) for a turn under 10 deg or a fly-over), less half the roll in and the bank's delay

fcs_function.name: ap/turn-rollout-deg
fcs_function.description: the track still to turn when the roll out starts: the turn rate times half the roll out and the delay

fcs_function.name: ap/turn-remaining-deg
fcs_function.description: the track still to turn to the next leg's course, in the turn's direction

fcs_function.name: ap/turn-xt-new-ft
fcs_function.description: the cross-track on the new leg's line, right of it positive

fcs_function.name: ap/turn-pred-b
fcs_function.description: the exit's cross-track on the new line per foot of radius: the arc's chord and the wind's push over its time

fcs_function.name: ap/turn-radius-star-ft
fcs_function.description: the radius of the arc from here that ends on the new line

fcs_function.name: ap/turn-bank-hi-deg
fcs_function.description: the most bank commanded in a turn: the sourced bank limit as flown, and the angle-of-attack cap

fcs_function.name: ap/turn-bank-pred-raw-deg
fcs_function.description: the bank that puts the arc's exit on the new line (the turn's own bank when it does not apply)

fcs_function.name: ap/turn-bank-cmd-deg
fcs_function.description: the bank commanded in the turn: the trimmed bank

fcs_function.name: ap/turn-phase-new
fcs_function.description: the turn's phase this frame

fcs_function.name: ap/bank-leg-deg
fcs_function.description: the bank on a leg: the leg's law; in the turn the bank fed forward; rolling out the heading law onto the next course

fcs_function.name: ap/bank-command-limit-deg
fcs_function.description: the bank command stops at 0.86 of the limit: turning, the bank overshoots its command and then settles above it (a proportional law; an integral was tried and overshot)

fcs_function.name: ap/bank-clip-deg
fcs_function.description: the bank command stops at the bank command limit; the turn on a leg, in its arc, has its own most (ap/turn-bank-hi-deg)

fcs_function.name: ap/bank-manual-deg
fcs_function.description: by hand: the stick's position is the bank

fcs_function.name: ap/bank-clipped-deg
fcs_function.description: inside the bank limit

actuator.name: ap/bank-target-deg
actuator.description: the bank command moves at 5 deg/s at most

fcs_function.name: ap/roll-law-deg
fcs_function.description: roll command, right wing down positive

fcs_function.name: ap/decrab-w-next
fcs_function.description: the decrab's weight: 0 on the final, from 8 ft of wheel height to 1 at 1 ft, 1 on the runway

fcs_function.name: ap/final-trk-err-deg
fcs_function.description: the ground track less the leg's course

fcs_function.name: ap/final-xt-rate-fps
fcs_function.description: the rate the cross-track grows at, right positive

fcs_function.name: ap/final-want-rate-fps
fcs_function.description: the cross-track rate the line asks for: the cross-track over 25 s, at most vg sin(30 deg), towards the line

fcs_function.name: ap/final-bank-p-deg
fcs_function.description: the bank the lateral acceleration asked for takes: the rate wanted less the rate there is, over 6 s

fcs_function.name: ap/final-xt-neg-ft
fcs_function.description: the integral's input: towards the line

switch.name: ap/trig-final
switch.test: ap/engaged == 1 ap/roll-mode gt 1 ap/leg-xt-ft lt 30 ap/leg-xt-ft gt -30

fcs_function.name: ap/bank-final-deg
fcs_function.description: the bank on the final: the lateral law of the landing task (roll mode 3)

fcs_function.name: ap/takeoff-roll
fcs_function.description: on the mains with steering on and not landing: the takeoff roll

fcs_function.name: ap/yaw-air-w-next
fcs_function.description: the weight of the airborne yaw law: 0 on the takeoff roll, rising to 1 over 3 s from lift-off

fcs_function.name: ap/beta-error-deg
fcs_function.description: sideslip less the pedals' (nose right is negative sideslip)

fcs_function.name: ap/beta-gated-deg
fcs_function.description: sideslip, faded out below 60 kt: it means nothing at a walk; off on the takeoff roll; faded out by the decrab's weight

fcs_function.name: ap/yaw-ground-deg
fcs_function.description: the ruddervators on the heading error to the course the line gives: help the nose wheel on the ground, and take the crab off in the air from the decrab's weight

fcs_function.name: ap/yaw-law-deg
fcs_function.description: ruddervators against each other, nose right positive: damper, sideslip to zero (interconnect with the ailerons: gain 0 for now)

fcs_function.name: ap/thrust-error-kt
fcs_function.description: slow is positive

fcs_function.name: ap/thrust-i-next
fcs_function.description: the speed law's integral: held while its throttle is at a limit and the error would take it further

fcs_function.name: ap/thrust-pi
fcs_function.description: the speed error's proportional and integral terms

fcs_function.name: ap/cl-level
fcs_function.description: the lift coefficient the aircraft flies at: weight over dynamic pressure and wing area (not limited as ap/cl-now is: the throttle tables look it up)

fcs_function.name: ap/alpha-spoiler-deg
fcs_function.description: the spoilers' effect on the level angle of attack, deg, by their position, the lift coefficient and Mach number (pathperf.py)

fcs_function.name: ap/alpha-level-deg
fcs_function.description: the angle of attack of level flight at this Mach number, lift coefficient and height, deg, body axes (pathperf.py)

fcs_function.name: ap/thrust-per-deg
fcs_function.description: the throttle a degree of flight path angle takes at this Mach number, lift coefficient and height (pathperf.py)

fcs_function.name: ap/throttle-level
fcs_function.description: the throttle for level flight at this Mach number, lift coefficient and height (pathperf.py)

fcs_function.name: ap/climb-rate-max-fps
fcs_function.description: the climb rate the thrust holds at this speed: the path angle the throttle above level flight makes (pathperf.py), at 0.85 of it

fcs_function.name: ap/descent-rate-idle-fps
fcs_function.description: the descent rate the speed law can fly without the spoilers: the path angle the level-flight throttle gives up going to idle, at 0.85 of it

fcs_function.name: ap/bias-throttle-next
fcs_function.description: the throttle baseline of the speed law: the throttle command while the laws are off, the table's at the start of the speed mode in flight, else held

fcs_function.name: ap/thrust-mode-prev-next
fcs_function.description: the thrust mode of the frame before

fcs_function.name: ap/engaged-prev-next
fcs_function.description: whether the laws were on in the frame before

fcs_function.name: ap/thrust-speed-raw
fcs_function.description: the speed law's throttle before its limits (the integral looks at it)

fcs_function.name: ap/thrust-speed
fcs_function.description: the thrust that holds the speed: the throttle at engagement, the path angle's feed-forward and the speed error's integral

switch.name: ctl/throttle-norm
switch.description: what the engine takes: the laws' throttle when engaged, the throttle command otherwise; the gust system's while it is on in the landing

fcs_function.name: ap/throttle-slewed-next
fcs_function.description: the laws' throttle with its rate limited in the vertical modes in the air: THROTTLE_SLEW_UP per second going up, THROTTLE_SLEW going down

fcs_function.name: ap/glide-height-ft
fcs_function.description: height of the glide path here: the leg ends at the aiming point

fcs_function.name: ap/glide-error-ft
fcs_function.description: high is positive (not clipped: the lead is compared with it, and the lead can be 300 ft or more)

fcs_function.name: ap/glide-sink-error-fps
fcs_function.description: sinking less than the path asks is positive

fcs_function.name: ap/glide-sink-want-fps
fcs_function.description: the sink the aircraft should lack at this height off the path (sinking less than the path asks is positive): none on it, below it the profile's

fcs_function.name: ap/glide-track-fps
fcs_function.description: the sink the aircraft lacks less what the profile asks: nothing when it flies the profile, ft/s

fcs_function.name: ap/glide-lead-ft
fcs_function.description: the height under the path the glide is taken over at: where the profile asks for the sink the aircraft lacks

switch.name: ap/trig-glide
switch.test: ap/engaged == 1 ap/land-mode == 1 ap/flare == 0 ap/rollout == 0 ap/glide-error-ft lt 30 ap/glide-error-ft gt -30

fcs_function.name: ap/spoiler-glide
fcs_function.description: spoilers hold the glide path: they follow the profile

switch.name: ap/latch-spoiler-base
switch.description: the spoiler setting at the start of the flare

fcs_function.name: ap/flare-sink-wanted-fps
fcs_function.description: the sink wanted in the flare: the approach's, falling with height to 1.6 ft/s at the ground

fcs_function.name: ap/spoiler-flare
fcs_function.description: in the flare the spoilers work on sink rate alone: they come in as far as the sink needs

fcs_function.name: ap/sel-spoiler-slewed-next
fcs_function.description: the spoiler selection with its rate limited while the glide is being flown (GLIDE_SPOILER_RATE a second), the selection itself otherwise

switch.name: ctl/spoiler-norm
switch.description: spoilers, 0 to 1 (1 is 45 deg)

fcs_function.name: ap/decel-error-g
fcs_function.description: wanted deceleration less the present one

fcs_function.name: ap/brake-taxi
fcs_function.description: taxi: brakes when over the speed, held on when stopped

fcs_function.name: ap/steer-limit
fcs_function.description: nose-wheel travel allowed, falling with speed

fcs_function.name: ap/steer-out-deg
fcs_function.description: the nose wheel: the law's when steering on the ground, the direct command otherwise

switch.name: ctl/pitch-deg
switch.description: both ruddervators, trailing edge down positive: nose down

fcs_function.name: ap/roll-direct-deg
fcs_function.description: direct law: the stick and roll-rate damping

fcs_function.name: ap/yaw-direct-deg
fcs_function.description: direct law: the pedals and the yaw damper

switch.name: ctl/roll-cmd-deg
switch.description: roll command, right wing down positive

switch.name: ctl/yaw-deg
switch.description: ruddervators against each other, nose right positive

switch.name: limits/latch-overstress
switch.description: past a limit: load factor 2.5 or -1, 200 KEAS, Mach 0.7. Latched until limits/reset. Load factor counts in the air only: on the wheels it is the gear's
switch.test:
velocities/ve-kts gt 200 velocities/mach gt 0.7
ap/on-mains == 0 accelerations/Nz gt 2.5
ap/on-mains == 0 accelerations/Nz lt -1

switch.name: limits/latch-failed
switch.description: past an ultimate: load factor 3.75 or -1.5, 230 KEAS. The structure is taken to have failed
switch.test:
velocities/ve-kts gt 230
ap/on-mains == 0 accelerations/Nz gt 3.75
ap/on-mains == 0 accelerations/Nz lt -1.5

fcs_function.name: ctl/aileron-deg
fcs_function.description: ailerons as the aerodynamic tables take them: right trailing edge down positive, which rolls left

fcs_function.name: ap/v-alt-ft
fcs_function.description: the height the vertical task is asked for

fcs_function.name: ap/v-err-ft
fcs_function.description: the height to go, up positive

fcs_function.name: ap/v-toward-fps
fcs_function.description: the climb rate towards the height

fcs_function.name: ap/v-sp-rate
fcs_function.description: the spoilers' slew rate, per second (the go-around's faster)

fcs_function.name: ap/v-gate-ft
fcs_function.description: the height to go at which the altitude mode takes over with no step in what it asks: where the profile asks for the climb rate there is

fcs_function.name: ap/v-rup-fps
fcs_function.description: the climb rate the thrust holds going up, the descent rate the speed law holds at idle going down

fcs_function.name: ap/v-short
fcs_function.description: a height change shorter than the capture of the rate the aircraft can hold is flown entirely under the profile, from no climb rate

fcs_function.name: ap/v-energy-short
fcs_function.description: a climb the thrust cannot hold level at the end of (the throttle for level flight here is at least 0.95): the altitude capture is not begun yet

fcs_function.name: ap/v-mode-raw
fcs_function.description: this frame's mode: 3 level (within the gate or a short change, not begun while the thrust cannot hold the height; or the height held), else 1 climb or 2 descent; the go-around climbs (full thrust) until the capture of its height

fcs_function.name: ap/v-level-new
fcs_function.description: the frame the level (a new one) begins

fcs_function.name: ap/v-from-eff
fcs_function.description: what the aircraft was doing when the capture began

fcs_function.name: ap/v-span-eff
fcs_function.description: how far out the capture began: the spoilers go in with the height left over all of it

fcs_function.name: ap/v-sp0-eff
fcs_function.description: the spoilers' command when the capture began: they go in from where they were

fcs_function.name: ap/vmode-next
fcs_function.description: the vertical task's mode: 1 climb, 2 descent, 3 level, 0 not on

fcs_function.name: ap/v-need-fps
fcs_function.description: the sink the path to the point asks for: the height over the target over the time to go, less the capture's time

fcs_function.name: ap/v-sp-i-next
fcs_function.description: the spoilers' integral on the sink the path asks for: held at nothing unless a descent is steering

fcs_function.name: ap/v-sp-descent
fcs_function.description: the spoilers in a descent: steering the slope onto the point (a path), else the fixed setting

fcs_function.name: ap/v-sp-want
fcs_function.description: the spoilers' command the task wants, before the slew

fcs_function.name: ap/spoiler-cmd-next
fcs_function.description: the spoilers' command moved towards what the task (or ap/sp-ext) wants at the slew rate, whichever way; held when neither has it

fcs_function.name: ap/tk-air
fcs_function.description: the takeoff item is on and the aircraft is airborne

fcs_function.name: ap/tk-done-next
fcs_function.description: the takeoff has handed over (latched while the item is on)

fcs_function.name: gear/gear-cmd-next
fcs_function.description: the gear comes up when the takeoff hands over

fcs_function.name: ap/tx-speed-leg
fcs_function.description: the taxi speed on a leg that ends in a bend: slow for the corner, over the last 350 ft

fcs_function.name: ap/tx-speed-last
fcs_function.description: the taxi speed on the last leg: down to a walk, then stopped on the point (or what it was, if it does not stop)

fcs_function.name: ap/tx-leg
fcs_function.description: the next taxi leg is to be taken

fcs_function.name: ap/tx-done
fcs_function.description: the taxi item is over

fcs_function.name: ap/ld-cap-new
fcs_function.description: the frame the glide is taken over

fcs_function.name: ap/ld-captured-next
fcs_function.description: the glide has been taken over (latched while the item is on)

fcs_function.name: ap/speed-cmd-next
fcs_function.description: the approach speed until the glide is taken

fcs_function.name: ap/sp-ext-next
fcs_function.description: the spoilers are the glide law's from the capture

fcs_function.name: ap/ld-done
fcs_function.description: the rollout is over

fcs_function.name: ap/ci-dn-ft
fcs_function.description: feet north of the centre

fcs_function.name: ap/ci-de-ft
fcs_function.description: feet east of the centre

fcs_function.name: ap/ci-out-deg
fcs_function.description: the bearing from the centre to the aircraft, -180 to 180

fcs_function.name: ap/ci-dist-ft
fcs_function.description: the distance from the centre

fcs_function.name: ap/ci-heading-deg
fcs_function.description: the heading that flies the circle, 0 to 360

fcs_function.name: ap/gs-throttle-target
fcs_function.description: the throttle the speed lost asks for (idle in the flare)

fcs_function.name: ap/gs-throttle-next
fcs_function.description: the gust system's throttle, rate limited

fcs_function.name: ap/gs-flare-extra-deg
fcs_function.description: pitch more in the flare for the sink the spoilers cannot take

fcs_function.name: ap/gs-detect
fcs_function.description: speed lost or sink beyond the path on the final, whatever the gust system is doing

fcs_function.name: ap/gs-detect-t-next
fcs_function.description: the last time the gust monitor met its threshold

fcs_function.name: ap/gust-alert
fcs_function.description: the gust alert: raised from the monitor and held GS_ALERT_HOLD_S
